h1: Text in pictures, translated where it is.
s1: Right-click a picture or drag over any part of the page. The original text is wiped and the translation set in its place.
s2: Pick <q>Translate picture</q> on any picture. The translation takes the colour, size and weight of the original, and a click on <q>List</q> shows it as text.
s3: Press <kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>T</kbd> or click the button in the popup, then drag over the text. Video frames, backgrounds and canvases too.
s4: Each piece of text with its translation, in a card next to the picture. Click a line to copy it, or copy them all at once.
s5: Quick needs no key: it reads the picture on your computer and Google Translate translates the text. Gemini, Claude or a local model read memes, handwriting and any language.
